result.instructions: Tools for Emma, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show me my Emma groups and how many active members each has."; "How did last month's mailings perform? Opens, clicks and opt-outs."; "Is jane@example.com in my audience? Which groups is she in?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Emma data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run emma_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run emma_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run emma_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. emma_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: emma_list_groups
tools.description: List the member groups (audience lists) of the Emma account with their active, opted-out and error member counts. Defaults to normal groups; group_types can add test and hidden groups.

group_types.description: g = group (default), t = test, h = hidden.

start.description: Offset of the first result (default 0). Use next_start from the previous reply.

tools.name: emma_get_group
tools.description: Get one member group with its member counts (active, opted-out, error).

tools.name: emma_list_group_members
tools.description: List the members of one group (email, status, custom fields). Paged: use next_start for more.

start.description: Offset of the first result (default 0). Use next_start from the previous reply.

tools.name: emma_list_members
tools.description: List the members (contacts) of the whole audience: id, email, status (a active, o opted out, e error), custom fields, bounce count. Paged: use next_start for more. With count_only the reply is just the number of members.

exclude_fields.description: Return only the base attributes, without custom fields (smaller reply).

count_only.description: Return only the number of members (count=true) instead of the list.

start.description: Offset of the first result (default 0). Use next_start from the previous reply.

tools.name: emma_get_member
tools.description: Get one member by id, with all custom fields, status, SMS status and bounce count.

include_deleted.description: Find the member even if archived.

tools.name: emma_find_member_by_email
tools.description: Find one member by email address, with all custom fields and status. A 404 means the address is not in the audience.

include_deleted.description: Find the member even if archived.

tools.name: emma_get_member_groups
tools.description: List the groups one member belongs to.

start.description: Offset of the first result (default 0). Use next_start from the previous reply.

tools.name: emma_get_member_mailings
tools.description: The mailing history of one member: which mailings they were sent and what they did with them.

start.description: Offset of the first result (default 0). Use next_start from the previous reply.

tools.name: emma_list_fields
tools.description: List the custom member fields of the account (shortcut names, display names, types).

start.description: Offset of the first result (default 0). Use next_start from the previous reply.

tools.name: emma_get_import
tools.description: Status and results of one bulk member import (by import id), or, without an id, the list of all imports of the account.

start.description: Offset of the first result (default 0). Use next_start from the previous reply.

tools.name: emma_list_mailings
tools.description: List mailings (campaigns): id, name, subject, sender, status (p pending, a paused, i injecting, s sending, x canceled, c complete, w waiting, u unapproved, f failed), type, recipient count, scheduled time. Defaults to standard and test mailings in all statuses, newest first. Paged: use next_start.

mailing_types.description: m standard (default with t), t test, r trigger/automated, s subject-line split test, c content split test.

is_scheduled.description: Only mailings that have a scheduled send time.

start.description: Offset of the first result (default 0). Use next_start from the previous reply.

tools.name: emma_get_mailing
tools.description: Get one mailing in full: content (HTML and plain text), recipients (groups, searches, segments), links, schedule, status.

include_segment_names.description: Add the names of the recipient segments.

include_subscription_names.description: Add the names of the recipient subscriptions.

tools.name: emma_list_mailing_members
tools.description: List the individual members a mailing was sent to (not groups or searches). Paged: use next_start.

start.description: Offset of the first result (default 0). Use next_start from the previous reply.

tools.name: emma_get_response_summary
tools.description: Month-by-month response statistics for the whole account: mailings, sent, delivered, bounced, opened, clicked, forwarded, opt-outs, sign-ups (test mailings excluded).

range.description: Date range YYYY-MM-DD~YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-01-01~2026-06-30; one side may be empty.

tools.name: emma_get_mailing_response
tools.description: Response summary of one mailing: recipients, sent, delivered, bounced, opened, clicked (unique and total), forwarded, opt-outs, sign-ups.

tools.name: emma_list_mailing_links
tools.description: The links of one mailing with their unique and total clicks.

start.description: Offset of the first result (default 0). Use next_start from the previous reply.

tools.name: emma_list_mailing_activity
tools.description: Who did what with one mailing: members it was sent to (sends), still in the queue (in_progress), delivered or bounced (deliveries), opened (opens), clicked (clicks), forwarded, opted out (optouts) or signed up (signups). Each row has the member's email and timestamp. Paged: use next_start.

delivery_type.description: Only for kind=deliveries: filter by delivery outcome (default all).

link_id.description: Only for kind=clicks: limit to one link (link_id from emma_list_mailing_links).

member_id.description: Only for kind=clicks: limit to one member.

start.description: Offset of the first result (default 0). Use next_start from the previous reply.

tools.name: emma_list_searches
tools.description: List the saved searches (dynamic segments) of the account, with their criteria.

start.description: Offset of the first result (default 0). Use next_start from the previous reply.

tools.name: emma_get_search_members
tools.description: The members that currently match a saved search. Paged: use next_start.

start.description: Offset of the first result (default 0). Use next_start from the previous reply.
